Hand-painted stylized game texture in a soft painterly style like a modern anime-inspired 3D RPG (AFK Journey), warm golden-afternoon palette. Seamless tileable square texture, strictly orthographic top-down view, flat even lighting with no directional shadows, no perspective, no horizon, no objects bigger than a hand, no borders, no frame, no text. Subject: an old village cobblestone pavement seen from above, rounded irregular stones in warm light grey, beige and faint lavender, thin sandy joints between the stones, a little moss in a few joints, uniform over the whole tile.
